scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Nov. 15 Mountain Songs matinee from becoming an avoidable stair-access problem for a neighborhood elder.
Emerging Need: Discount balcony tickets become risky only after Kunsang’s attendance and Sahana’s purchase are observable, then a short no-cost exchange window appears.
Decision Context: Email, messages, calendar, and wallet records establish the outing, seats, order number, and cutoff; a private stored note supplies the seating boundary.
Consequence: Timely attention can prevent an uncomfortable or unsafe balcony arrival while preserving the outing, but after the exchange release the prevention route is gone.

parameter.subject: Nov 15 Mountain Songs matinee: balcony sale opens
parameter.body: Discount balcony seats for the Sunday, Nov. 15, 2:00 p.m. Mountain Songs matinee are open through Nov. 10. The balcony uses two short stair flights; ground-floor exchanges are possible while aisle seats remain.

parameter.content: If Sahana still wants the Mountain Songs matinee, Kunsang Amla said she would enjoy coming with us. Sunday Nov. 15 at 2 works for her if we keep the outing simple.

parameter.title: Mountain Songs matinee with Kunsang Amla
parameter.description: Neighborhood family outing plan for the Mountain Songs matinee; ticket purchase pending.
parameter.location: Queens Community Arts Hall, Jackson Heights

parameter.description: Three discounted balcony matinee tickets for Nov. 15 Mountain Songs.

parameter.subject: Order MSONG-BAL-4427 seating and exchange window
parameter.body: Your three tickets are Balcony Row B seats 7-9 for the Nov. 15 Mountain Songs matinee. If any guest needs ground-floor aisle seating, reply with the order number before 1:30 p.m. today; the box office can move the whole party at no charge while the remaining aisle seats are held.

parameter.subject: Ground-floor exchange window closed for MSONG-BAL-4427
parameter.body: The 1:30 p.m. same-day exchange hold for order MSONG-BAL-4427 has expired, and the remaining ground-floor aisle seats have been released to the waitlist. The balcony seats remain valid for Nov. 15.
